decisions.reason: The Big Block trigger and eligible-population change does not alter the independent Small Block mechanism; the message's Small Block changes are already recorded.
The complete same-message ticket-lifecycle Event already records the independent counters, Big Block eligibility window, and post-draw reset.
The existing same-message MODIFY already updates eligible winners to holders of tickets issued since the applicable block's previous draw.
Changing the Big Block draw trigger and eligible population does not change the rule that secondary-sale royalties fund the prize pools.
The client explicitly says manual claim remains identical, so the prize-claim workflow requires no change.
The Big Block drawing rules do not change the coded-referral commission or ticket award, which are already captured from the same message.
The metadata requirement already has a same-message MODIFY exposing both ticket counters and permanent badges; the source Event adds no further metadata change.
The client states that the random ticket for mints without a referral remains identical; the Big Block draw change does not alter this reward.
The source preserves secondary royalties and only clarifies their pool-funding and no-ticket effects; it does not change the royalty-enforcement requirement.
